g.title: Long shot. A street at dusk. Alice, left, pointing, shouting; Bob, centre. Alice: Bob! Don't move!
Close-up. A street at dusk. Bob, centre, scared. Bob: Why? What is it?
Medium shot. A street at dusk. Alice, left, pointing, shouting. Alice, shouting: Right behind you!
Full shot. A street at dusk. Bob, centre, hands on hips, surprised. Bob: ...A puddle?
Full shot. A street at dusk. Alice, centre, laughing, looking at Bob; Bob, centre, angry. Alice: Your new shoes, Bob! Bob: Very funny.
